_rationale: Updated for the CA 2024 bracket refresh (FTB tax-year-2024 thresholds; prior data was 2023 figures mislabeled 2024). CA state tax on a $100k pension is now $5,327 (graduated 2024 brackets above the $5,540 std ded), down from $5,438 under the stale 2023 thresholds. Net CA = $100k − $13,170 federal − $5,327 CA = $81,503/yr. Net FL = $86,830/yr (unchanged). Portfolio: starts at $500k, accumulates net income each year with 0% growth. Year-1 balance = 500k + 81,503 = 581,503; year-3 (last full CA year) = 500k + 3·81,503 = 744,509; year-4 (first FL year, balance after CA-3 cashflow) = 500k + 4·81,503 = 826,011.
